trigger.description: An ee.daemon.context read-only pack request sets requireCachedLocalEmbedder=true on a cold daemon whose process-cached verified local semantic model is not loaded. The daemon refuses to load the model on demand so read-only pack clients fall back to canonical local retrieval or warm the daemon first.
trigger.invocation: DaemonRequest{method="ee.daemon.context", params={"requireCachedLocalEmbedder":true}} sent to a cold daemon
